comment: The map-source feature's words — the installed data and the business of keeping it current.

rows.definition: A configured place the app fetches map data from, with the metadata that describes it.
rows.not: not an installation, which is a fetched copy on this device

rows.definition: One fetched basemap copy on this device, with the directory it occupies.
rows.not: not the repository it came from
anchor: rule: an installed-map update is staged beside its target and swapped in when complete

rows.definition: A newer copy of an installed basemap, staged and swapped in when it is complete.
rows.not: not a download, which is the transfer rather than the swap

rows.definition: Whether a repository's data can be fetched and installed right now.
rows.not: not the data's version, which says what the copy is
